## Data cleaning
```{r}
## --- Parameters setting ---
maturity_age <- 1     # maturity age; fecundity < this age = 0
estimate_tail <- TRUE # whether to estimate survival for open-ended tail
tail_k <- 2           # number of last survival values used to estimate tail

## --- Load dataset ---
great_tit <- read.csv("Great Tit.csv")

## Check required columns
if(!all(c("x","Nx","noffspring") %in% names(great_tit))){
  stop("Dataset must contain columns: x, Nx, noffspring")
}

## Sort by age
great_tit <- great_tit[order(great_tit$x), ]

```

## MPM building for +senescence model
```{r}
## --- Survival to next age: s_x = N[x+1]/N[x] ---
sx <- c(great_tit$Nx[-1] / great_tit$Nx[-nrow(great_tit)], NA)
sx[!is.na(sx)] <- pmin(pmax(sx[!is.na(sx)], 0), 1)

## --- Estimate open-ended tail survival s_omega if needed ---
if (is.na(sx[length(sx)]) && estimate_tail) {
  sx_non_na <- sx[!is.na(sx)]
  if (length(sx_non_na) >= tail_k) {
    s_omega <- mean(tail(sx_non_na, tail_k), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else if (length(sx_non_na) >= 1) {
    s_omega <- tail(sx_non_na, 1)
  } else {
    s_omega <- 0
  }
  s_omega <- pmin(pmax(s_omega, 0), 1)
  sx[length(sx)] <- s_omega
}

## --- Fecundity per female (post-breeding): f_x = rho_f * (offspring / N_x) ---
fx <- (great_tit$noffspring / great_tit$Nx)
fx[great_tit$x < maturity_age] <- 0
fx[!is.finite(fx)] <- 0
sx[!is.finite(sx)] <- 0

## Add back to dataframe for checking
great_tit$sx <- sx
great_tit$fx <- fx

cat("== Check head ==\n")
print(head(great_tit, 10))

## --- Build U (k x k) survival/aging matrix with open tail ---
ages <- great_tit$x
k <- length(ages)
Umat <- matrix(0, nrow = k, ncol = k,
            dimnames = list(paste0("age", ages), paste0("age", ages)))

for (i in 1:(k-1)) {
  Umat[i+1, i] <- sx[i]
}
Umat[k, k] <- sx[k]  # open tail: stay in last age with s_omega

## --- Build F (k x k) fecundity matrix (post-breeding, only first row) ---
Fmat <- matrix(0, nrow = k, ncol = k,
            dimnames = list(paste0("age", ages), paste0("age", ages)))
Fmat[1, ] <- fx

## --- Combine to Leslie/Lefkovitch matrix ---
Amat <- Umat + Fmat

cat("\n== Dimension check ==\n")
cat("Umat:", paste(dim(Umat), collapse=" x "), "\n")
cat("Fmat:", paste(dim(Fmat), collapse=" x "), "\n")
cat("Amat:", paste(dim(Amat), collapse=" x "), "\n")


## Rename the original model variables for clarity
sx_senescence <- sx
fx_senescence <- fx
Umat_senescence <- Umat
Fmat_senescence <- Fmat
Amat_senescence <- Amat

```

## MPM for no senescence model
```{r}
## ======================================================
## No-senescence model: keep sx and fx constant from maturity_age onwards
## ======================================================

# 1) Locate maturity index in the age vector
i_m <- which(ages >= maturity_age)[1]
if (is.na(i_m)) {
  stop("maturity_age is above the maximum age in the data; please lower maturity_age.")
}

# 2) Create "no-senescence" versions of sx and fx
sx_no_senescence <- sx_senescence
fx_no_senescence <- fx_senescence

#    Freeze sx and fx from maturity onward to their maturity-age values
sx_no_senescence[seq(i_m, k)] <- sx_senescence[i_m]
fx_no_senescence[seq(i_m, k)] <- fx_senescence[i_m]

#    Ensure pre-maturity fecundity is zero under post-breeding convention
if (i_m > 1) {
  fx_no_senescence[seq(1, i_m - 1)] <- 0
}

#    Handle any non-finite values (safety)
sx_no_senescence[!is.finite(sx_no_senescence)] <- 0
fx_no_senescence[!is.finite(fx_no_senescence)] <- 0

# 3) Build Umat_no_senescence with open tail (self-loop at last age)
Umat_no_senescence <- matrix(0, nrow = k, ncol = k,
                             dimnames = list(paste0("age", ages), paste0("age", ages)))
for (i in 1:(k - 1)) {
  Umat_no_senescence[i + 1, i] <- sx_no_senescence[i]
}
# open tail: last age stays with survival equal to the maturity-age sx
Umat_no_senescence[k, k] <- sx_no_senescence[k]

# 4) Build Fmat_no_senescence (post-breeding; fecundity only on the first row)
Fmat_no_senescence <- matrix(0, nrow = k, ncol = k,
                             dimnames = list(paste0("age", ages), paste0("age", ages)))
Fmat_no_senescence[1, ] <- fx_no_senescence

# 5) Combine to get Amat_no_senescence
Amat_no_senescence <- Umat_no_senescence + Fmat_no_senescence

# 6) Quick checks
cat("\n== No-senescence model checks ==\n")
cat("Umat_no_senescence:", paste(dim(Umat_no_senescence), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("Fmat_no_senescence:", paste(dim(Fmat_no_senescence), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("Amat_no_senescence:", paste(dim(Amat_no_senescence), collapse = " x "), "\n")

# Column sums of U should be ≤ 1 (death prob = 1 - colSums(U))
if (any(colSums(Umat_no_senescence) > 1 + 1e-8)) {
  warning("Some columns of Umat_no_senescence sum to > 1; please check sx_no_senescence values.")
}

```

## PLOTTING
#Lifespan

```{r}
## --- Exact lifespan PMF: p[t] = m^T U^{t-1} x0, t = 1,2,... ---
## min lifespan = 1 (sex maturity age)
exact_lifespan_pmf <- function(U, mixdist, max_t = 5000, tol = 1e-12) {
  k <- nrow(U)
  m <- 1 - colSums(U)         # per-age death at step end
  x <- as.vector(mixdist)     # x0
  stopifnot(abs(sum(x) - 1) < 1e-8)

  pmf <- numeric(max_t)
  for (t in 1:max_t) {
    pmf[t] <- sum(m * x)      # p_t = m^T x_{t-1}
    x <- as.vector(U %*% x)   # x_t = U x_{t-1}
    if (1 - sum(pmf) < tol) { pmf <- pmf[1:t]; break }
  }
  data.frame(lifespan = seq_along(pmf), pmf = pmf / sum(pmf))
}

moments_from_LS_pmf <- function(df) {
  x <- df$lifespan; p <- df$pmf
  mu <- sum(x * p)
  va <- sum((x - mu)^2 * p)
  sk <- sum(((x - mu)^3) * p) / (va^(3/2))
  c(mean = mu, var = va, skew = sk)
}

# exact PMFs
LS_exact_sen <- exact_lifespan_pmf(Umat_senescence,    mixdist_senescence,    max_t = 10000)
LS_exact_no  <- exact_lifespan_pmf(Umat_no_senescence, mixdist_no_senescence, max_t = 10000)

mom_exact_sen <- moments_from_LS_pmf(LS_exact_sen)
mom_exact_no  <- moments_from_LS_pmf(LS_exact_no)

cat("\n[Exact PMF moments]\n")
print(rbind(Senescence = mom_exact_sen, `No-senescence` = mom_exact_no))

cat("\n[Analytic]\n")
print(rbind(
  Senescence      = c(mean = mean_lifespan(Umat_senescence,    mixdist_senescence),
                      var  = var_lifespan (Umat_senescence,    mixdist_senescence),
                      skew = skew_lifespan(Umat_senescence,    mixdist_senescence)),
  `No-senescence` = c(mean = mean_lifespan(Umat_no_senescence, mixdist_no_senescence),
                      var  = var_lifespan (Umat_no_senescence, mixdist_no_senescence),
                      skew = skew_lifespan(Umat_no_senescence, mixdist_no_senescence))
))

## 画图（自动裁到99.9%质量，和你LRO一样的风格）
qcut <- 0.999
xmax_exact <- max(
  LS_exact_sen$lifespan[which(cumsum(LS_exact_sen$pmf) >= qcut)[1]],
  LS_exact_no$lifespan [which(cumsum(LS_exact_no$pmf)  >= qcut)[1]]
)
LS_exact_sen$model <- "Senescence"
LS_exact_no$model  <- "No-senescence"
LS_exact_all <- rbind(LS_exact_sen, LS_exact_no)

pLS_exact <- ggplot(subset(LS_exact_all, lifespan <= xmax_exact),
                    aes(x = lifespan, y = pmf, color = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_area(aes(fill = model), alpha = 0.10, position = "identity") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Senescence"="#1F78B4", "No-senescence"="#E31A1C")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Senescence"="#1F78B4", "No-senescence"="#E31A1C")) +
  labs(x = "Lifespan (steps, min=1)", y = "Probability mass (PMF)",
       title = "Lifespan distribution (Exact; truncated at 99.9% mass)") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, xmax_exact)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")
pLS_exact

```


#Lifetime reproductive outcome
```{r}
## ===== LRO Monte Carlo that matches analytic functions =====
## Assumptions exactly align with mean_LRO / var_LRO_mcr / skew_LRO:
## - Reward per step at age z: eff[z] <- colSums(Fmat)[z]
## - Reward distribution by `repro_var`:
##     "poisson"  : Y ~ Poisson(eff[z])
##     "fixed"    : Y <- eff[z]         (deterministic; may be non-integer numeric)
##     "bernoulli": Y ~ Bernoulli(eff[z])  (requires 0 <= eff[z] <= 1)
## - Survival/transition: with prob s=sum(U[,z]) survive and go to z' ~ U[,z]/s; else die
## - Start age z0 ~ mixdist  (must sum to 1)

library(ggplot2)

.draw_LRO_once <- function(U, eff, z0, repro_var = "poisson", max_steps = 5000) {
  k <- nrow(U)
  z <- z0
  Tsum <- 0
  for (t in 1:max_steps) {
    # reward at current age (post-breeding in the same step)
    if (repro_var %in% c("poisson","Poisson")) {
      Tsum <- Tsum + rpois(1, lambda = max(eff[z], 0))
    } else if (repro_var %in% c("fixed","Fixed")) {
      Tsum <- Tsum + eff[z]
    } else if (repro_var %in% c("bernoulli","Bernoulli")) {
      p <- min(max(eff[z], 0), 1)  # clamp to [0,1] just in case
      Tsum <- Tsum + rbinom(1, size = 1, prob = p)
    } else {
      stop("repro_var must be 'poisson', 'fixed', or 'bernoulli'.")
    }
    # survival to next step
    s <- sum(U[, z])
    if (s <= 0) break                # certain death at end of this step
    if (runif(1) > s) break          # die at end of this step
    # survive: transition to next age conditional on survival
    probs <- U[, z] / s
    z <- sample.int(k, size = 1, prob = probs)
  }
  Tsum
}

simulate_LRO_MCR <- function(Umat, Fmat, mixdist, n = 200000,
                             repro_var = "poisson", max_steps = 5000) {
  k <- nrow(Umat)
  # rewards per step (from-age = column)
  eff <- as.vector(colSums(Fmat))
  # start distribution
  mixdist <- as.vector(mixdist) / sum(mixdist)
  cs <- cumsum(mixdist)
  z0 <- findInterval(runif(n), cs) + 1L
  # simulate
  Ts <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) Ts[i] <- .draw_LRO_once(Umat, eff, z0[i], repro_var, max_steps)
  Ts
}

pmf_from_sample_int <- function(Ts, qcut = 0.999) {
  Tmax <- as.integer(quantile(Ts, probs = qcut, names = FALSE, type = 1))
  tab <- tabulate(Ts[Ts <= Tmax] + 1L, nbins = Tmax + 1L)  # bin for T=0 at index 1
  pmf <- tab / sum(tab)
  data.frame(LRO = 0:Tmax, pmf = pmf, cdf = cumsum(pmf), xmax = Tmax)
}

moments_from_pmf_int <- function(df) {
  x <- df$LRO; p <- df$pmf
  mu <- sum(x * p)
  va <- sum((x - mu)^2 * p)
  sk <- sum(((x - mu)^3) * p) / (va^(3/2))
  c(mean = mu, var = va, skew = sk)
}

## ===== Run for both models, compare to analytic =====
set.seed(42)
n_sims <- 200000
repro_var <- "poisson"  # <- should be the same method for skew_

# mixing distributions you already computed
# mixdist_senescence    <- mixing_distro(Amat_senescence,    Fmat_senescence)
# mixdist_no_senescence <- mixing_distro(Amat_no_senescence, Fmat_no_senescence)

Ts_sen <- simulate_LRO_MCR(Umat_senescence,    Fmat_senescence,    mixdist_senescence,
                           n = n_sims, repro_var = repro_var)
Ts_no  <- simulate_LRO_MCR(Umat_no_senescence, Fmat_no_senescence, mixdist_no_senescence,
                           n = n_sims, repro_var = repro_var)

PMF_R_sen <- pmf_from_sample_int(Ts_sen, qcut = 0.999)
PMF_R_no  <- pmf_from_sample_int(Ts_no,  qcut = 0.999)

mom_MC_sen <- moments_from_pmf_int(PMF_R_sen)
mom_MC_no  <- moments_from_pmf_int(PMF_R_no)

# Analytic moments
meanR_sen <- as.numeric(mean_LRO(Umat_senescence, Fmat_senescence, mixdist_senescence))
meanR_no  <- as.numeric(mean_LRO(Umat_no_senescence, Fmat_no_senescence, mixdist_no_senescence))

varR_sen  <- as.numeric(var_LRO_mcr(Umat_senescence, Fmat_senescence, "poisson", mixdist_senescence))
varR_no   <- as.numeric(var_LRO_mcr(Umat_no_senescence, Fmat_no_senescence, "poisson", mixdist_no_senescence))

skewR_sen <- as.numeric(skew_LRO(Umat_senescence, Fmat_senescence, "poisson", mixdist_senescence))
skewR_no  <- as.numeric(skew_LRO(Umat_no_senescence, Fmat_no_senescence, "poisson", mixdist_no_senescence))

cat("\n[From Monte Carlo PMF]\n")
print(rbind(Senescence = mom_MC_sen, `No-senescence` = mom_MC_no))

cat("\n[Analytic]\n")
print(rbind(
  Senescence    = c(mean = meanR_sen, var = varR_sen, skew = skewR_sen),
  `No-senescence` = c(mean = meanR_no,  var = varR_no,  skew = skewR_no)
))

# deltas
delta_sen <- c(mean = mom_MC_sen["mean"] - meanR_sen,
               var  = mom_MC_sen["var"]  - varR_sen,
               skew = mom_MC_sen["skew"] - skewR_sen)
delta_no  <- c(mean = mom_MC_no["mean"] - meanR_no,
               var  = mom_MC_no["var"]  - varR_no,
               skew = mom_MC_no["skew"] - skewR_no)
cat("\n[Δ MC - Analytic]\n")
print(rbind(Senescence = delta_sen, `No-senescence` = delta_no))

## ===== Plot (x trimmed at 99.9% mass, same style as your lifespan figure) =====
PMF_R_sen$model <- "Senescence"
PMF_R_no$model  <- "No-senescence"
PMF_R_all <- rbind(PMF_R_sen[, c("LRO","pmf","model")],
                   PMF_R_no[,  c("LRO","pmf","model")])

xmax_all <- max(PMF_R_sen$xmax[1], PMF_R_no$xmax[1], na.rm = TRUE)

pLRO_mc <- ggplot(subset(PMF_R_all, LRO <= xmax_all),
                  aes(x = LRO, y = pmf, color = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_area(aes(fill = model), alpha = 0.10, position = "identity") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Senescence"="#1F78B4", "No-senescence"="#E31A1C")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Senescence"="#1F78B4", "No-senescence"="#E31A1C")) +
  labs(x = "LRO (T)", y = "Probability mass (PMF)",
       title = sprintf("LRO distribution (Monte Carlo, %d sims; truncated at 99.9%% mass)", n_sims)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax_all)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

print(pLRO_mc)


```
